### Software / Analytics

*   [Rybbit](https://rybbit.io) - Web and products analytics that is easy to setup and more intuitive (alternative to Google Analytics). ([Demo](https://demo.rybbit.io/21/), [Source Code (⭐8.1k)](https://github.com/rybbit-io/rybbit)) `AGPL-3.0` `Docker`

### Software / Miscellaneous

*   [Anubis](https://anubis.techaro.lol/) - Web AI firewall utility which protects upstream resources from scraper bots. ([Source Code (⭐13k)](https://github.com/TecharoHQ/anubis)) `MIT` `Docker/deb/Go`
*   [Warracker](https://warracker.com) - Warranty tracker that lets you monitor expiry dates, upload receipts/files, and get alerts before warranties expire. ([Source Code (⭐790)](https://github.com/sassanix/Warracker)) `AGPL-3.0` `Docker`
